title: Record the bounded-mean PPO failure to walk
summary: The run completes 2000 updates. Its final policy stays within deterministic action bounds and passes quiet screens, but fails all ten movement probes. We preserve complete captures, force records and a forward video. Reward v2 remains unchanged; the fixed-trajectory audit does not establish learnability.
next: Review the failed movement result and reward audit before defining another learner or reward comparison. Human walking labels and the AMP comparison remain pending.
